title: Kumiki FilmDocument
description: Generated by npm run film:schema. Do not edit.

appearance.description: Scene recipes are drawn for dark.

drift.description: A slow push-in across each scene, as a share of its size (0.04 is 4%), so that no moment is fully still.

outputs.description: The first output is the default. Each one is authored at its own size, never cropped from another.

loop.description: A film that loops, as Shorts and Reels replay on their own: its last `frames` (default 12) dissolve into its first frame, so the replay starts on the picture it ends on, with no visible seam.

mood.description: Mood words, each moving the preset in its own direction (see `LOOK_MOOD_EFFECTS`).

contrast.description: Contrast around middle grey: 1 is unchanged, above 1 an S-curve, below 1 flatter.

saturation.description: 0 is black and white, 1 unchanged, above 1 more saturated.

blacks.description: Lifted blacks, a matte toe: 0 to about 0.15.

whites.description: Rolled-off whites, the shoulder: 1 is unchanged, 0.9 a soft print.

shadowTint.description: Colour added in the shadows and in the highlights (split toning), about -0.08 to 0.08 per channel.

mixer.description: A channel mixer: each row makes one output channel from red, green and blue. For a black-and-white filter or a teal push.

posterize.description: Flat bands of colour, as cel paint: the number of levels per channel, 4 to 16.

grain.description: Grain strength, 0 to 1, and grain size in pixels at 1080p.

grainMono.description: Black-and-white grain, as on monochrome stock.

halation.description: Halation: the coloured glow around highlights from light scattered in the emulsion.

glowThreshold.description: The level above which highlights glow, 0.5 to 0.95.

glowRadius.description: Glow radius as a share of the frame's short side.

streaks.description: Horizontal flare streaks from bright points, as an anamorphic lens draws them.

weave.description: Gate weave: frame-to-frame drift in pixels at 1080p. About 1 for 1970s 35 mm, 4 or more for home 8 mm.

leaks.description: Warm light leaks drifting across the frame, 0 to 1.

chroma.description: Video: colour bleeding sideways from each edge, in pixels at 1080p.

tracking.description: Video: tracking noise bands that roll through now and then, 0 to 1.

softness.description: A slight overall softness, in pixels at 1080p.

blinds.description: Shadows of window blinds across the frame, as hard-lit noir throws them, 0 to 1.

matte.description: An aspect matte. It covers the frame edges, where titles sit, so keep titles inside it.

outline.description: Ink lines drawn where colours meet, as a cel animator outlines a painted drawing, 0 to 1.

boil.description: Line boil: drawn edges wobble a little on every held drawing, as a redrawn animation's lines do, 0 to 1. For drawn scenes, not photographs. (Doc 34, A7.)

cadence.description: `smooth`: every frame. `twos`: each drawing held two frames, as cel animation. `step`: each frame held `hold` frames, the undercranked, step-printed stutter.

camera.description: `locked`: no movement. `drift`: the film's slow push. `float`: a slow, stabilised sway. `handheld`: a live operator.

shake.description: Strength of the float or handheld movement, 0 to 1.

pushAtTurn.description: A slow push-in after a scene's story turn, as a share of the frame (0.04 is 4%).

fovScale.description: Field of view for 3D shots: below 1 a longer lens (flatter, more compressed), above 1 a wider one. The subject keeps its size.

display.description: CSS font stacks for display type and body type.

bedTags.description: Catalog tags a bed for this look should carry.

lowpassHz.description: Muffles beds that set no filter of their own, for lo-fi and period looks.

color.description: The brand's primary colour, for emphasis, the end card and the bug.

background.description: The ground cards are set on.

cta.description: One call to action, and where it leads (a URL or a handle).

bug.description: A small mark in a corner of every scene but the end card, so the brand is seen from the first frame.

width.description: Optional intrinsic pixel size. Lets overlays follow an object-fit: cover crop in any aspect.

layers.description: Caller cutouts (alpha) the camera walks past, each at a depth; at least the background must lie beyond them.

name.description: Optional wordmark and line set under the mark on the final beat.

placement.description: Ground contact point in the environment plate (normalized) and mark height as a fraction of plate height.

treatment.description: "grounded" stands the mark in the clearing as an object; "graphic" keeps it a quiet floating sign; "cinematic" composes a photographic title sequence.

markScale.description: Cinematic treatment only: size of the mark in its lockup, as a multiple of the default (11% of the frame width, 22% in portrait), 0.5..2.5. The wordmark and line stay their size beneath it.

material.description: Grounded finish: "solid" fills the artwork's silhouette with `color`; "artwork" keeps its own colours.

foreground.description: Procedural near-lens forms layered in front of the caller layers: broadleaf "foliage" (default), "tropical" palm fronds, "rock" or "none".

light.description: Where the sun shaft enters (normalized stage x, at the top edge) and its colour.

walk.description: Walk: travel distance (0.5..12 depth units, default 1.7), sideways truck (−0.5..0.5) and walking bob (0..1). The environment plate sits at `environmentDepth` (default 30, beyond every layer).

focus.description: Thin-lens focus. `from`/`to` are focus depths (same units as layer depth): focus starts on the hero plane and racks to the clearing over `rack` (fractions of the walk, default [0.4, 0.8]). `aperture` scales the circle of confusion (0..3, default 1; 0 keeps everything sharp). Default from 6, to the environment.

haze.description: Atmospheric depth that thins as the camera approaches, 0..1.

cues.description: What it does, in scene frames: an action by name (wave, point, cheer…), an expression, or speech for `speak` frames.

light.description: The scene's light on the character, so drawn art sits in a photograph or a 3D set: `color` (#rrggbb) multiplies it, as coloured light does, and `edge` (#rrggbb) draws a thin rim of light on the `side` the scene's sun is on.

shadow.description: A soft contact shadow under its feet, 0 (none) to 1. Use it where the feet are in the picture.

source.description: Frames of content the scene plays: what its recipe is timed in, its moments and its checks.

holds.description: Moments to slow to near-stillness: a content frame, or the name of one of the scene's moments, and output frames to hold it.

slow.description: Speed during a hold, as a fraction of normal.

ramp.description: Output frames to ramp between fast and slow.

exit.description: Ramp up into the cut over this many output frames at the end, and come down out of the cut over `enter` at the start. Pair with a cut or a whip.

repeats.description: Times they play again after the first.

path.description: Where the lens is: its centre at scene frames, as fractions of the frame. It glides between them and rests at the ends.

appear.description: Frames the lens takes to come in from flat glass at its first point, and to go back out at its last.

questionEmphasis.description: Substring of the question that carries the stakes; set in the accent colour.

answerSteps.description: Answer delivered as ordered beats; `answer` stays the canonical accessible text. A step without `frame` lands on the reveal cue.

annotations.description: Arrows, routes, rings, labels and spotlights on the subject, timed to beats or steps. Subject-space points need the subject's intrinsic width/height to track a crop.

revealImpact.description: Reveal punctuation. "flash" adds an exposure bloom; "kick" adds a decaying camera kick.

questionLabel.description: Eyebrow beside the docked question. Default "Question"; "" hides it.

look.description: Film treatment. Letterbox applies to landscape only.

name.description: Place name, set as the display title.

eyebrow.description: Short kicker above the name, e.g. a region.

context.description: One line of context held beside the silhouette.

imagery.description: 1–6 photographs or clips, shown in order inside the silhouette.

compositeNote.description: Required, localizable disclosure that the imagery is framed by the outline, not an aerial view.

credit.description: Optional source credit line, shown verbatim beside the disclosure.

projection.description: Orthographic projection centre; defaults to the boundary's spherical centroid.

mapContext.description: Context coastlines during the locate move. Default "coastlines".

locateZoom.description: Opening scale relative to the final framing, 0.1..1. Default 0.3.

verticalExaggeration.description: Height multiplier, 1..5. Anything but 1 must be declared on screen via `exaggerationNote`.

route.description: Geographic route, in travel order, inside the terrain bounds. `smoothing` (km, 0..2, default 0.6) averages the drawn line along its length to calm raster staircases; endpoints stay exact.

destination.description: Held at the end: `label` pins the place on the terrain, `detail` is the large readout (e.g. an elevation) and `detailLabel` names that readout.

routeNote.description: Honest provenance of the route line, e.g. "computed path, not a surveyed trail".

light.description: Sun azimuth (degrees clockwise from north) and altitude (3..80°). Default 250° / 24°.

palette.description: Hypsometric colour stops in metres; default is elevation-relative.

water.description: Colour for elevations at or below 0 m.

camera.description: Oblique expedition view: yaw (0 = from the south), pitch 10..70°, distance scale 0.5..3.

layers.description: Caller cutouts (alpha) the camera walks past, each at a depth; at least the background must lie beyond them.

name.description: Optional wordmark and line set under the mark on the final beat.

placement.description: Ground contact point in the environment plate (normalized) and mark height as a fraction of plate height.

treatment.description: "grounded" stands the mark in the clearing as an object; "graphic" keeps it a quiet floating sign; "cinematic" composes a photographic title sequence.

markScale.description: Cinematic treatment only: size of the mark in its lockup, as a multiple of the default (11% of the frame width, 22% in portrait), 0.5..2.5. The wordmark and line stay their size beneath it.

material.description: Grounded finish: "solid" fills the artwork's silhouette with `color`; "artwork" keeps its own colours.

foreground.description: Procedural near-lens forms layered in front of the caller layers: broadleaf "foliage" (default), "tropical" palm fronds, "rock" or "none".

light.description: Where the sun shaft enters (normalized stage x, at the top edge) and its colour.

walk.description: Walk: travel distance (0.5..12 depth units, default 1.7), sideways truck (−0.5..0.5) and walking bob (0..1). The environment plate sits at `environmentDepth` (default 30, beyond every layer).

focus.description: Thin-lens focus. `from`/`to` are focus depths (same units as layer depth): focus starts on the hero plane and racks to the clearing over `rack` (fractions of the walk, default [0.4, 0.8]). `aperture` scales the circle of confusion (0..3, default 1; 0 keeps everything sharp). Default from 6, to the environment.

haze.description: Atmospheric depth that thins as the camera approaches, 0..1.

spreads.description: Two to four spreads, turned in order. The last spread's art is the portal into `world`.

title.description: Chapter title and line held over the world.

light.description: Warm light colour over the world once it is alive.

states.description: Optional authored image state after each action; matches actions.length.

actionTargets.description: Optional normalized cursor/focus target for every action.

focalAnchor.description: Normalized subject placement and an explicit virtual 2D camera path.

focalSize.description: Height of the revealed subject as a share of the frame. A distant subject reads as scale.

parallax.description: Screen-space depth ratio for the transparent foreground plane.

pages.description: Legacy (v1) pages: each becomes a spread with heading and text on the verso and the image as a plate on the recto. Prefer `spreads`; see `pageTurnSpreads`.

spreads.description: Two or more facing-page spreads in reading order. Each turn reveals the next one.

direction.description: Which way a leaf travels: "left" (default) for left-to-right books, "right" for right-to-left books.

roughness.description: Paper roughness 0..1 (default .9), leaf thickness in mm (default .22), age 0..1 (foxing and edge tone).

accent.description: Printed accent for drop caps and rules on the page (default a rust red).

eyebrow.description: Chapter kicker above the title, e.g. "Chapter three".

credit.description: Provenance line for the page art; shown small with the running head.

turns.description: One cue per turn (spreads − 1), absolute frames in order. Default: evenly paced after the establishing shot.

stiffness.description: Paper stiffness 0..1: 0 is a limp leaf with a deep trailing curl, 1 is card that barely bends. Default .45.

renderer.description: "auto" uses the bending WebGL book when the host provides it and WebGL is available; "flat" forces the 2.5D book.

narrative.description: Programme title, set on the time anchor.

eyebrow.description: Programme eyebrow on the anchor, e.g. "A short history of flight".

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for every date, range and number. Default "en".

dateFormat.description: Date line precision; never finer than the data. Default "auto".

transition.description: Default transition and length for every boundary.

counter.description: Event counter template with {index} and {count}; "" hides it. Default "{index} / {count}".

summary.description: Final hold: the change across the period. `span` overrides the computed "N years" readout; false hides it.

rail.description: Rail: proportional graduations (elapsed only) and which year labels show during events.

palette.description: CSS colours. Each is also overridable from outside through --km-tj-bg, --km-tj-ink, --km-tj-muted, --km-tj-rail.

typography.description: CSS font-family stacks for titles, body copy and the numeric readout.

backdrop.description: "blur" fills the frame with a defocused, darkened copy of the current plate. Default "blur".

rimIntensity.description: Subtle rim shimmer intensity 0..1, used for Fresnel-style edge shading.

causticIntensity.description: Caustic / light-sweep intensity 0..1 (the panel does not claim physical raytracing).

scene.description: The scene to flash forward to: usually the climax, in the last third of the film.

at.description: The moment the flash-forward cuts away on: one of the scene's cues, or a content frame.

frames.description: How long the flash-forward runs, ending on `at`.

title.description: The title that takes the viewer back: "Two days earlier."

in.description: Frames the film takes to come up from the colour.

out.description: Frames the film takes to go down to the colour at its end.

text.description: Verbatim substring of the cue text, in order.

confidence.description: Alignment confidence in [0,1] when the aligner provides one.

lanes.description: Each `assetRef` is relative to the film file.

links.description: Tie a sound or word to `<scene id>/focus`, `/reveal`, `/resolve`, or `<scene id>/<beat id>`.

accents.description: Place a whoosh on each transition, and a riser and a hit on each turn, from a kit folder next to the film file.

cues.description: Named sounds from the kit, tied to a moment by name, so a re-timed film keeps its sound in step.

beds.description: Recorded ambience from the sound catalog, baked to length at render.

licenseRef.description: Rights reference that covers the whole mix.

startFrame.description: Film frame where this lane's audio time 0 plays.

alignmentId.description: Narration: the alignment describing this lane's words.

beatGrid.description: Music: a constant-tempo beat grid (or supply beats in an alignment-free list).

required.description: Missing audio data for a required lane is an error instead of a warning.

subframeOffset.description: Optional sub-frame position [0, 1); the visual cue remains on `frame`, while the FFmpeg mix uses the precise timestamp (to the nearest ms).

visualEventId.description: A MotionDirector schedule/cue ID or any event ID in `visualEvents`.

offsetFrames.description: Desired visual frame relative to the audio anchor (e.g. -3 to lead a word).

toleranceFrames.description: Allowed |visual − desired| before the link is late or early. Default 1.

strict.description: Out-of-tolerance links are errors instead of warnings.

sound.description: A sound name in `kit.json`, such as `paper-touch`.

offsetFrames.description: Frames after the moment. Negative leads it.

room.description: The space around this sound. It needs a kit from the sound catalog.

pan.description: Where the sound sits: -1 is left, 1 is right.

distance.description: Metres from the camera. Farther is quieter, duller and wetter.

sound.description: A catalog sound with the `loop` tag.

lowpassHz.description: Muffles the bed, as if heard through water or a wall.

durationFrames.description: Defaults to the rest of the film.

duckDb.description: How far narration pushes everything else down, in dB. Defaults to 12 when a film has narration.

limit.description: Add a limiter, for a mix of real recordings. Without it the master is one gain, which stops at the true peak ceiling.
